verdict.rationale: Beamer's docs only make a generic claim that users can 'collect and prioritize feedback' and mention a public/private roadmap. Nothing documents scoring feedback or ideas with fields such as value, risk, impact, confidence, or effort. A generic prioritization claim is not evidence of a structured scoring capability, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can score feedback and ideas using fields like value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort
